name: root-crate-cache-split
body: Wave F of the multi-wave task-19 root-crate decomposition (behaviour-preserving, CLI unchanged). `src/cache.rs` is decomposed into `src/cache/{manifest,fragment,factstore}.rs`; `src/cache/mod.rs` holds the module declarations and re-exports, with the file-level `#![allow(dead_code)]` in `mod.rs`. `src/cache/tests.rs` stays put, so the test module FQN `rust.apg.cache.tests` stays, and the module FQN `rust.apg.cache` stays via `mod.rs`. The single durable edge `solution.component.scan-driver` —implemented-by→ `rust.apg.cache.fragment.rebase` names the free fn `rebase` in `fragment.rs`. The container-level edge `solution.container.scanner-cli` —implemented-by→ `rust.apg.cache` and the `solution.component.scan-driver` —implemented-by→ `rust.apg.splice` edge stay.
